    cin >> input;

    string current = {input[0]};
    vector<string> candidates = {current};

    for (size_t i = 1; i < input.size() - 1; ++i) {
        string three, two;

            three = input.substr(i, 3);

    }

#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

void generate(const string &s, size_t pos, string cur, vector<string> &res) {
    if (pos == s.size()) {
        res.push_back(cur);
        return;
    }
    if (pos == 0) {
        generate(s, 1, string(1, s[0]), res);
        return;
    }
    if (pos == s.size() - 1) {
        generate(s, pos + 1, cur + s.back(), res);
        return;
    }

    // Check for "dot"
    if (pos + 2 < s.size() - 1 && s.substr(pos, 3) == "dot") {
        generate(s, pos + 3, cur + '.', res);
        return;
    }
    // Check for "at"
    if (pos + 1 < s.size() - 1 && s.substr(pos, 2) == "at") {
        // branch: treat as '@'
        generate(s, pos + 2, cur + '@', res);
        // branch: treat as literal "at"
        generate(s, pos + 2, cur + "at", res);
        return;
    }
    // normal character
    generate(s, pos + 1, cur + s[pos], res);
}

int main() {
    string input;
    cin >> input;
    vector<string> candidates;
    generate(input, 0, "", candidates);
    sort(candidates.begin(), candidates.end());
    cout << candidates.front() << '\n';
    return 0;
}
